description: Symplectic and non-symplectic time integration methods for Hamiltonian dynamics, from 1st-order Euler to 4th-order Yoshida
mathematical_formalization: H(q,p) = T(p) + V(q); symplectic map preserves dp^dq; leapfrog: q1 = q0 + dt*p_{1/2}, p1 = p_{1/2} + dt/2 * F(q1)
implementation_hypothesis: Implement symplectic Euler, leapfrog (KDK), and Yoshida 4th-order as composable integrator functions accepting force callbacks
experiment_seed: Measure convergence order by halving dt and checking error reduction factor (2x for Euler, 4x for leapfrog, 16x for Yoshida)
